title: One Joke to Rule them All? On the (Im)possibility of Generalizing Humor Detection

live_model.evidence: "To create negative examples that closely match the positive class in content, writing style, and semantics, we used GPT-4 Turbo (OpenAI, 2023) in a few-shot setup." (see prompt in Appendix A)

prompt.note: Prompt is printed, but only supports a data-generation role, not a benchmark claim.

claim.metric: none tied to a benchmark capability; a generation-quality check exists (97.37% of 3,000 manually reviewed outputs preserved style/content) but this is a QA check on synthetic-data generation, not a classification/accuracy claim
claim.location: Sec 2 (dataset construction); Tables 2-4 report only Mistral/LLaMA-2 fine-tuned classifier accuracies, never a GPT-4 Turbo row

data.source: Four existing humor datasets (Table 1: e.g. Reddit jokes, Amazon, Headlines, Dad Jokes)

notes: GPT-4 Turbo's only role is generating negative (non-humorous) examples for a humor-detection dataset (role A, data generator); all reported accuracy figures (up to 75%, Tables 2-4) belong to fine-tuned Mistral/LLaMA-2 classifiers.
